correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and rotation equivalence are fixed. Exact Eulerian bijection, forced-path contraction, directed BEST coefficient one, and Fourier cofactor evaluation prove U_2(n)=2^floor((n−2)/2) for all n≥3. Independent full graph cofactors (n=3..10), compressed cofactors and Euler-tour enumeration (n=3..12), raw circular words (n=3..6), all agree. Rooting and n=3 are explicit.

value.rationale: An established fundamental family of fixed-weight universal cycles has an intrinsic population-count question not settled by giving a single explicit tour. The all-length closed formula exhibits exponential growth in half the parameter and uses a structural reflection/rotation contraction, providing a non-routine classification useful for further exact enumerative and sampling questions.
